blocks.html: If your Trader Joe’s Gift Card has a peel or scratch-off PIN on the back, you can click the button below to check your balance online. Please note that by clicking through to this service, you will be leaving the Trader Joe’s website and entering your gift card information on our partner’s platform.

blocks.html: If your Trader Joe’s Gift Card does not have a peel or scratch-off PIN, not to worry! You can call 1-888-556-6450 to check your balance by phone. In fact, even if your card DOES have a peel or scratch-off PIN, you can still check your balance by phone if you’d prefer to do so.
And of course, you can also bring your Trader Joe’s Gift Card to Trader Joe’s, where a Crew Member can check your balance at the register.
